enforcement_authorities: Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU)
compliance_deadlines: 2 February 2025: AI system definition and Chapter I and II provisions, including Article 5 prohibited AI practices, entered into application
implementation_notes: Guidelines are explicitly non-binding (paragraph 7: 'The Guidelines are not binding'). Authoritative interpretation rests solely with the CJEU. Guidelines were adopted in parallel with Commission guidelines on prohibited AI practices. They clarify the seven-element definition of 'AI system' under Article 3(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and note that systems based solely on rules defined by natural persons or limited to basic data processing fall outside the AI system definition.
